languageRequirements.minimum: Multiple class levels are offered starting from beginner; the brochure states no minimum HSK score. The emailed online placement test is compulsory before registration and classes and is used for class placement.

faculty.zh: 东华大学国际教育中心

overview.en: Full-time interactive short-term Chinese language learning in Shanghai, with practical communication, cultural activities, language practice and an online review platform. This proposal covers the 2027 winter route only.
overview.zh: 上海全日制互动式短期汉语学习，含实用交流、文化活动、语言实践和在线复习平台；本提案仅覆盖2027冬季路线。

qualification.en: Completion exam required; certificate of completion issued.
qualification.zh: 须参加结业考试，颁发结业证书。

campus.en: West Yan’an Road Campus, Donghua University, Shanghai
campus.zh: 东华大学上海延安西路校区

languagePolicy.en: The current winter programme describes an immersive Chinese language environment. The standing teaching philosophy, still linked in the current Chinese Language Programs index, explicitly uses Chinese as a medium language of communication and practice in and outside class. This establishes Chinese as a learning/communication medium; no claim is made that every explanation is exclusively in Chinese or that English support is guaranteed. Multiple levels start from beginner, and the compulsory placement test determines class level rather than an HSK entry threshold.
languagePolicy.zh: 当前冬季项目说明营造沉浸式汉语环境；当前汉语项目目录仍列的教学理念明确发挥汉语作为媒介语沟通，并在课内外使用汉语练习。此处确认汉语为学习交流媒介，不声称每一解释均仅中文或保证英语辅助。开设零起点等层次，须完成分班测试，简章未给HSK入学分数。

curriculumHighlights.en: Practical Chinese classes for daily communication, with multiple levels from beginner; a class opens with at least eight students.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 面向日常交流的实用汉语课，含零起点等多个层次，每班至少8人开班。

curriculumHighlights.en: Cultural lectures and activities such as calligraphy and traditional crafts; some afternoon activities require advance application.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 文化讲座与书法、传统手作等活动，部分下午活动须提前报名。

curriculumHighlights.en: Teacher-guided language practice in Shanghai neighborhoods, shopping districts and cultural landmarks, with an online platform for review.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 在教师指导下于上海社区、商圈和文化地标开展语言实践，辅以在线复习平台。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen, in good physical and mental health, aged between 16 and 55.
eligibility.zh: 身心健康的非中国籍公民，年龄16–55岁。

eligibility.en: Submit the online application and pay the application fee as notified; the university reviews the complete application and may request additional materials by email. Admission is subject to that review.
eligibility.zh: 提交网申并按通知交报名费；学校审核完整申请，可能邮件通知补材料，录取以审核结果为准。

eligibility.en: Complete the compulsory online placement test before registration/classes. Class-level change may be requested during the specified first-week period if the course difficulty differs substantially from actual proficiency.
eligibility.zh: 报到和上课前须完成网上分班测试；如课程难度与实际水平明显不符，可在开课第一周规定时间申请调班。

applicationMaterials.en: Clear, complete scanned passport copy in PDF format. Applicants already in mainland China must also upload copies of the visa page and entry-stamp page; failure to do so may prevent visa processing or enrollment, with consequences borne by the applicant.
applicationMaterials.zh: 清晰完整的护照扫描件，PDF格式；已在中国大陆者须附签证页及入境章页，否则可能无法办理学习签证或入学，后果由申请人承担。

applicationMaterials.en: Electronic front-facing bareheaded ID photograph in JPG format, complying with passport-photo requirements; used for the student ID card.
applicationMaterials.zh: JPG格式正面免冠电子证件照，按护照照片要求提供，用于学生证。

applicationMaterials.en: Correctly complete personal information and intended programme in the DHU Students Online Application System. Select Full-time: General Chinese Language (A), Summer/Winter Chinese Program, and the corresponding term/programme. Pay the fee online within 3–4 working days as requested by the university email, and no later than the published application deadline.
applicationMaterials.zh: 在东华大学学生在线申请系统准确填个人信息和拟申请项目，选择 Full-time: General Chinese Language (A), Summer/Winter Chinese Program 及相应学期；按学校邮件要求3–4个工作日内在线缴费，且不晚于申请截止。

applicationMaterials.en: Submit any additional documents specifically requested by the university by email in time. The winter guide lists age eligibility from 16 but does not set out a separate guardian document condition; applicants aged 16–17 should confirm any additional minor formalities with DHU.
applicationMaterials.zh: 及时提交学校邮件要求的补充材料。冬季简章年龄从16岁起，但未单列监护文件条件；16–17岁申请人应向东华确认未成年人附加手续。

notes.en: Existing programme and cycle identities are reused. The original exact course period is January 6–January 26, 2027; the old guessed one-month duration is removed. Registration/check-in January 4–5, 2027. Deadline November 30, 2026; no opening date is published, so opensOn is null rather than treating the July 10, 2026 page release as an opening date. Classes 09:00–11:45 China time Monday–Friday, with some afternoon cultural activities requiring advance application; at least eight students per class. CNY3600 covers this winter course, not a semester or annual fee. CNY600 registration/application fee must be paid by the deadline; waiver is available to current/former DHU students or new applicants recommended by DHU students. Application fee is non-refundable; tuition is fully refundable if study terminates before instruction starts and not refundable once instruction starts. Online payment via WeChat, Alipay, Visa or MasterCard. Admission review usually takes 2–4 weeks and is not a guarantee; admitted students receive an electronic admission notice, must pay tuition on time, prepare entry as instructed and register on time. DHU issues X2-related study documents according to actual entry/existing visa circumstances; for study under180 days the brochure describes the digital DQ form. Housing is optional off-campus or by separate on-campus application, subject to room availability and university allocation; no housing price is supplied by this programme page. The common Vacation brochure requires international-student insurance but phrases its validity sentence specifically as covering summer study; no winter insurance price or term is invented. Chinese-medium evidence combines this current programme’s immersive Chinese environment with the Chinese-as-medium teaching policy still linked from the current programme index (article id c5220a328420). Only the winter route is proposed; the same table also has two summer options, and these are not represented as covered by this record.
notes.zh: 复用既有项目与cycle身份；保留课程原文2027年1月6日至26日，删除旧估算1个月。1月4–5日报到，2026年11月30日截止；未公布开放日，opensOn置空，不把7月10日网页发布日期冒作开始申请日。周一至周五09:00–11:45，部分下午文化活动须提前申请，每班至少8人。3600元为本冬季项目费，非学期或年费。600元报名费须截止前付，在读/往届东华学生或由东华学生推荐者可申请豁免；报名费不退，开课前终止学习全额退学费、开课后不退。支持微信、支付宝、Visa/MasterCard；审核通常2–4周并非保证，录取者按通知及时交费、准备入境并报到。X2相关文件依实际入境或现持签证发，少于180天学习简章说明数字DQ。校外自行住宿或另申请校内宿舍，校内受房型、余量、申请情况影响，不保证房源；本页未给房价。Vacation简章要求购买保险，但有效期一句专写summer，未猜冬季保期及保险价。汉语媒介证据来自当前沉浸式项目说明，结合当前汉语目录仍列的c5220a328420教学理念“汉语作为媒介语”。本提案仅冬季，未把同表两条暑期路线当作已覆盖。

notes.en: Classes run January 6–26, 2027, and include a final exam and completion certificate. Current or former DHU students, and new applicants recommended by a DHU student, may receive an application-fee waiver.
notes.zh: 课程时间为2027年1月6日至26日，包含期末考试并颁发结业证书。东华大学在读或往届学生，以及由东华大学学生推荐的新申请人，可申请免报名费。
notes.ru: Занятия проходят с 6 по 26 января 2027 года, включая итоговый экзамен и сертификат. Текущие и бывшие студенты DHU, а также рекомендованные ими новые заявители могут получить освобождение от сбора.
